title: CineCLI: a cross-platform movie browser for the command line

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Ever wished your terminal could browse movies? Meet Cinici, a cross-platform movie browser for the command line. Search movies straight from YTS. Inspect full details, ratings, and screenshots, all without leaving your terminal. Found something you like? One command launches the magnet link directly into your Torrent client or downloads the Torrent file if you prefer. It even auto selects the best torrent based on quality and seed
